error: Counts the starting amount as the first advance.
shows: The held amount is counted again.
example: From 5, two advances are 6 and 7; 5 and 6 is one actual advance.
if_many: Hold the starting amount and mark each new advance. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Counts every object to find a fact.
shows: An efficient mental route is still developing.
example: Use known 5 + 2 = 7 versus recounting seven singles.
if_many: Recall an easy fact and derive a nearby one mentally. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Uses unequal graph units.
shows: A response is not matched to one equal place.
example: One clip spans two cells while other clips get one.
if_many: Give each response one symbol or one equal cell. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Starts a bar at 1.
shows: A tick label is mistaken for a unit interval.
example: The distance from 1 to 6 is five cells; from 0 to 6 it is six.
if_many: Trace the interval from 0 to 1. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Adds counts to find a difference.
shows: The child combines instead of comparing.
example: 6 and 4 differ by 2; 10 is their combined count.
if_many: Match the parts and circle only what remains unmatched. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Calculates with the givens before locating the unknown.
shows: The role of the missing quantity is skipped.
example: 10 grows to 12 by 2; the sum 22 does not describe the change.
if_many: Draw the situation and place the square for the missing amount before calculating. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Proposed parts do not make the given whole.
shows: The groups were not recombined to check the total.
example: 17 is 10 and 7; 10 and 8 makes 18.
if_many: Rejoin the proposed parts and compare with the whole. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Chooses an operation based on more or fewer alone.
shows: The word replaces reasoning about sizes.
example: If Bo has 9 and one fewer than Al, Al has 10. Subtracting would give 8.
if_many: Name the larger amount before choosing a calculation. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Rejects an equation because the total is on the left.
shows: Reads equals as an instruction.
example: 7 = 5 + 2 shows the same quantities as 5 + 2 = 7.
if_many: Represent equal quantities on both sides and read the equation in both directions. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: The removed part is given as what remains.
shows: The complementary part is not distinguished.
example: 7 - 5 leaves 2. The 5 was taken away.
if_many: Cover the named part and identify the other one. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Reverses the larger and smaller owners.
shows: Attaches the comparison to the wrong person.
example: Bo has one fewer than Al, so Al has the longer tape.
if_many: Label both owners before attaching the extra span to the larger amount. Confirm the child’s route before assigning a letter.

error: Drops the new ten after combining ones.
shows: The composed ten is absent from the total.
example: 34 + 47 is 81; writing 71 drops one ten.
if_many: Circle ten drawn ones and transfer their value to the tens.

error: Subtracts the smaller digit from the larger in each column.
shows: Treats digits as quantities without their places.
example: 53 − 7 is 46; reversing the ones gives 54.
if_many: Draw the whole start and exchange before removing the stated amount.

error: Keeps the original tens after trading one.
shows: Counts one ten twice.
example: 53 − 7 is 46; keeping all five tens gives 56.
if_many: Cancel one ten as its ten ones appear.

error: Uses the wrong operation on the givens in a one-step story.
shows: Misses the relationship between the unknown and known amounts.
example: Of 16 crayons, 4 are short and 12 are long. Adding 16 and 4 gives 20.
if_many: Label the whole, known part and unknown before calculating.

error: Chooses an operation from more or fewer in opposite-language comparisons.
shows: Uses a keyword in place of the relationship.
example: Al has 36 and 27 fewer than Bo. Bo has 63; a keyword subtraction gives 9.
if_many: Name the larger amount and align both tapes.

error: Stops after the first action.
shows: Takes the intermediate result for the requested quantity.
example: 25 − 2 + 8 gives 31; stopping at 25 − 2 gives 23.
if_many: Put the second action on the first drawing and check the ending count.

error: Leaves out an addend in a four-addend total.
shows: Loses one quantity while grouping.
example: 18 + 42 + 35 + 15 is 110. Omitting 15 gives 95.
if_many: Tick each original addend once when it enters a group.

error: Gives a result or procedure without explaining equal value.
shows: Names a step without a reason.
example: 34 + 25 is 59 from five tens and nine ones. Compare I added.
if_many: Connect a written step to the same value in the drawing.

error: Accepts parts whose sum differs from the whole.
shows: Changes the total when splitting or rejoining.
example: 41 + 26 restores 67. The parts 41 and 27 make 68.
if_many: Enclose the parts in the original outline and recombine them.

error: Leaves gaps between units.
shows: Parts of the length are uncovered.
source: Geometric Measurement, draft, PDF pages 8 and 12 to 13
example: A row of equal pencils touches along an edge. The same count with gaps does not cover it.
if_many: Slide equal paper pieces together and recheck a new edge. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Starts at 1 and reports the end reading.
shows: Treats the first numeral as the start.
source: Geometric Measurement, draft, PDF pages 8 and 12 to 13
example: The model ruler measures 18 cm from zero. From 1 it ends at 19.
if_many: Align at zero and trace the first space. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Counts ruler marks as length units.
shows: Counts boundaries instead of intervals.
source: Geometric Measurement, draft, PDF pages 8 and 12 to 13
example: There are 19 boundaries around the 18 spaces in the model ruler.
if_many: Shade the spaces and count each once. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Expects more of a larger unit on the same length.
shows: Conflates size of unit and number of units.
source: Geometric Measurement, draft, PDF pages 8 and 12 to 13
example: The hook path takes six short pieces or three long pieces.
if_many: Cover the same length in two sizes and match endpoints. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Skips empty values on a plot scale.
shows: Treats number positions as categories.
example: The blank 41 tick stays between 40 and 42.
if_many: Restore consecutive ticks using a checked ruler as a model. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Uses one mark per distinct value.
shows: Drops observations that have the same length.
example: Two readings of 40 need two marks at 40.
if_many: Match one paper mark to each reading. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Subtracts in a joining story.
shows: Treats two parts as a comparison.
example: 32 and 48 cm joined give 80 cm. Their difference is 16 cm.
if_many: Lay tapes end to end and bracket the whole. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Labels the longer whole as the difference.
shows: Confuses the whole with its excess.
example: The 89 cm rod extends 36 cm past the aligned 53 cm rod.
if_many: Align starts and bracket only the uncovered span. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Treats an inch and a centimeter as equal.
shows: Uses an unrelated unit benchmark.
example: A checked inch reference extends past an aligned centimeter reference.
if_many: Overlay checked references with a common start. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Measures straight across a curve.
shows: Measures a different path.
example: A flexible paper tape follows a bowl rim. A straight chord crosses it.
if_many: Follow the named route with flexible tape. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Puts the unknown at the end regardless of the story.
shows: Misplaces the unknown in the relationship.
example: 81 minus a missing cut leaves 16. The cut is 65 cm; 81 + 16 joins start and end.
if_many: Label before, change and after. Place the square before choosing a calculation. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Stops at the first answer of a two-step story.
shows: Mistakes an intermediate result for the ending.
example: From 86 cm, the first cut of 39 leaves 47. The next cut of 24 leaves 23.
if_many: Use the first result as the new start and circle what the question asks for. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Drops a newly composed ten.
shows: Ten grouped ones never enter the tens sum.
example: 32 + 48 gives 80. Leaving out the composed ten gives 70.
if_many: Group ten drawn ones and count their ten in the sum. Use two minutes for the move and three for a fresh case.

error: Counts the starting mark as the first traveled unit.
shows: Counts boundaries as lengths.
example: Ten spaces from zero reach 10; including the starting mark in ten counts ends the trace at 9.
if_many: Cover each traveled interval once with one equal paper unit. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Places consecutive whole numbers at unequal intervals.
shows: Uses order without a fixed-size unit.
example: Label the joins of equal paper units. Pulling one interior tick away changes the lengths of its neighboring units.
if_many: Rebuild consecutive positions with one repeated paper edge. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Requires all subtraction strategies to move left.
shows: Does not use subtraction as a missing-addend relationship.
example: For 84 − 7, counting up from 7 to 84 shows the gap 77.
if_many: Rejoin the gap and smaller amount in a missing-addend equation. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Reports the larger endpoint as the difference.
shows: Uses a position in place of a distance.
example: The difference between 84 and 7 is the 77-unit distance between them.
if_many: Bracket and label the distance between the endpoints. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Starts every added jump at zero.
shows: Leaves the initial addend out of the representation.
example: One jump of 7 from 51 reaches 58. A jump from 0 to 7 represents only the added amount.
if_many: Mark the initial quantity before drawing the added distance. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Uses a leftward move for an addition increase.
shows: Direction is disconnected from the operation in this context.
example: From 51 a right jump of 7 reaches 58. Left 7 reaches 44.
if_many: Trace the rightward increase and pair it with its equation. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Changes the ones digit for a tens move.
shows: Treats tens as ones.
example: One ten beyond 45 is 55. One space reaches 46.
if_many: Overlay a ten-space strip and trace how ten unit intervals fit. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Copies a known quantity into the unknown.
shows: The known and unknown roles in the picture blur together.
example: The square in □ + 15 = 42 is 27. Copying 15 into it gives 30 in all.
if_many: Cover the unknown and label what is known. Test the proposed amount in the situation. Use an independent fresh recheck.

error: Stops after the first change in a two-step story.
shows: Leaves a stated change out of the representation.
example: In 80 to 78 to 73, stopping at 78 leaves out the five put away next.
if_many: Draw both changes in order before identifying the final amount. Use an independent fresh recheck.
